svg.metadata: {"changes": "Isolate original race-route geometry; omit annotations, pit lanes, alternative routes, sectors, flags, backgrounds and white halo. Black paint, rounded stroke and proportional padded SVG viewport; original path data and transforms are unchanged.", "credit": "HumanBodyPiloter5", "historicalApplicability": "File explicitly identifies Formula One 2019/2021 route. Select the black filled race-route ribbon path828, retaining Mistral/Chicane Nord (turns 8/9) and V2 Verrerie S, omit blue pit lane. RacingCircuits identifies F1 as 1C with V2 Verrerie S (1C-V2); official 2021 and 2022 pages/maps use 5.842 km chicane route.", "license": "CC0-1.0", "licenseUrl": "https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/", "page": "https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Le_Castellet_circuit_map_Formula_One_2019_and_2021_with_corner_names_English_19_07_2021.svg", "sourceSha256": "df9a7f80b307a93e9a7a4cdfe567882aa668a899012b6ae84f5026bd87f31035", "url": "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f2/Le_Castellet_circuit_map_Formula_One_2019_and_2021_with_corner_names_English_19_07_2021.svg"}
svg.desc: Authentic source transforms applied; proportionally sampled route with subpixel curve tolerance; uniform black double contour with transparent center and background; no labels.
